principle_violations.reason: The sum method in the AreaCalculator class directly checks for specific shape types (Square and Circle) and calculates their area. To add support for new shapes, this method will need to be modified, which violates the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a common interface or superclass for all shapes that includes a method to calculate the area. Each shape will implement this method, allowing the sum method in AreaCalculator to call it for any shape without knowing its type.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
